title: EPA ECHO Source-Designated Active Regulated Facilities
description: Governed weekly ECHO Exporter layer for FAC_ACTIVE_FLAG=Y facilities with valid reported U.S. physical addresses, source-specific status, FRS and program identifiers, classifications, coordinates and precision metadata, ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, exclusions, and explicit gaps.
coverage_claim: Facilities whose ECHO FAC_ACTIVE_FLAG is Y and whose source row contains a valid reported U.S. physical address/ZIP; not all businesses and not proof of general operating status.
